proxy_limits: Rounded counts; target PRSUs, not maximum actual payout.
Gross grants before future forfeitures; not GAAP expense, actual cash compensation, or exact economic cost.
ESPP issued shares multiplied by annual estimated fair value is an approximation; issue and grant cohorts need not match.
Acquisition-retention awards can elevate particular years; post-acquisition annual recurring budget is not fully disclosed.
future_policy: Annual grant-date economic-value charge approximates replacement compensation as if cash-paid. Base 10% of revenue initially fades to 6% only by FY2037; management_delivery 10% to 6%; downside 11% to 7%. This charges new service/grants, never the old unamortized expense ledger again. Absolute annual grant budgets rise with scale; no assumption grants become costless.
legacy_policy: All awards outstanding at the chosen date belong in equity claim allocation according to instrument terms. Do not add January 17m unvested units to August 30.581074m combined stock/options. Future tax withholding on those gross award claims represents cash-versus-net-share settlement of the same award; do not deduct again from FCFF while retaining gross award dilution. This equity-valuation rule does not fund or eliminate actual withholding cash. Separate treasury sensitivities schedule legacy withholding under BOTH future compensation policies. No actual vesting schedule is inferred from H1 cash.
tax_policy: Normalized cash tax applies to expensed-R&D EBIT after new-grant economic cost; this smooths eventual ordinary compensation deductions and is not an assertion of immediate grant-date tax deductibility. No excess exercise windfall/DTA cash added. Tax/payable uncertainty is separately gated.
margin_policy: Cost starts from ex-SBC operating-cost budgets and subtracts future grant charge once. No subsequent annual dilution from the same newly charged grants in a fixed current-claim model; future buybacks are not a substitute for compensation expense.
sensitivity_policy: Hold non-SBC gross margin, cash R&D, cash SG&A and revenue fixed when varying grant ratio. Incremental research allocation responds only for the 70% of new compensation attributed to R&D; FCFF capitalization identity remains exact.

treasury_translation.cash_replacement: The economic new-grant budget is literally cash-paid in this counterfactual policy; legacy equity-settlement cash remains additional treasury use.
treasury_translation.equity_settlement: Reverse new-grant economic expense and its modeled tax benefit, then pay assumed future-cohort withholding. Do not add the same future awards as new valuation claims. Employee contributions and employer deductions on vesting are not credited without evidence.
treasury_translation.scope_warning: The treasury cash screen is a conditional financing analysis, not a second equity valuation or an assertion about actual grant timing.
